replacement.title: Purpose-to-Measure Mapping
replacement.definition: Describe the association's concrete activities in §2 and assign those measures to each retained charitable purpose so that direct implementation of every purpose is evident.

patches.decision_note: The evidence defines an independently required mapping between each charitable purpose and its concrete implementation measures, which is distinct from selecting and legally wording the purposes.
The supplied evidence does not safely resolve whether the final purpose clause retains art and culture alone or also education and public and vocational training.
